name: leiden_msm_agreement
caption: Adjusted Rand index between Leiden communities (time-blind) and MSM macrostate assignments, trajectory-bootstrap CI. High ARI with n_macro=1 is agreement that both methods collapsed, not discovery of the same rich state set.
alt_text: Adjusted Rand index between Leiden communities (time-blind) and MSM macrostate assignments, trajectory-bootstrap CI. High ARI with n_macro=1 is agreement that both methods collapsed, not discovery of the same rich state set.
limitations: The CI resamples trajectories on frozen labels. Cross-space ARI of MSM labels (bge-m3 vs qwen3-embed-8b) on qwen is 0 because one space chose n_macro=1. UMAP is not used for any number here.
